title: OCC Attempt (v0.2 core, candidate draft)
$comment: 执行计量原子。spec/PROTOCOL_v0.2.md §2.7。用量 MUST 标注 self_reported；MUST NOT 记录凭据、账号或完整对话记录。

model_capability_tier.$comment: 模型能力等级/类别，MUST NOT 为具体账号或密钥标识。

self_reported.$comment: 固定 true。实现 MUST NOT 将自报用量呈现为已核实计量。

model_setup.description: Self-reported, record-only description of how the result was produced (spec/PROTOCOL_v0.2.md §8.2.1). Used only to judge whether replicated results were independent; never a restriction or an acceptance condition. Only locus is required; every other field is optional and at the participant's chosen granularity. MUST NOT contain account identifiers, API keys, email addresses, billing or plan information, or session data.

locus.description: Inference locus, declared honestly. A self-reported participant_local is not verification; the project MUST NOT publicly claim local inference it cannot verify.

self_reported.description: Constant true. MUST NOT be presented as verified.

model_family.description: Optional. Model family at whatever granularity the participant chooses. Not an account, deployment or key identifier.

prompt_template_ref.description: Optional. Reference to a published prompt template (for example one shipped with the task package), not the full prompt or conversation.
